title: Lamb Sausages/kebabs
ingredients: 500 g boneless lamb from either leg or shoulder (allow 750 g if you buy lamb on the bone)
1 - 2 green chillies, seeded and finely chopped
method: Finely mince the lamb and pork fat together in either a food processor or mincer
Combine with the breadcrumbs, egg and seasonings. Fry a small piece to test the seasoning
Divide the mixture into 6 - 8 patties, brush with olive oil and grill both sides
